create_VoxtralMultimodalProcessor: create a VoxtralMultimodalProcessor instance with hf_config, server_args, and a processor for speech-to-text inference
build_input_ids_with_audio: build input_ids by tokenizing a Mistral prompt and inserting BEGIN_AUDIO and AUDIO tokens for each audio clip

parse_mistral_prompt: parse a Mistral-formatted prompt string into a list of role-based messages with system, user, and assistant roles
find_audio_offsets: find consecutive runs of audio token IDs in an input_ids list and return their start and end offsets
